heroDescription: We build free, fast, and beautiful developer tools that respect your privacy.
mission: ZebraCode was created to provide developers with a set of essential online utilities that work instantly, without ads, tracking, or registration. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — your data never leaves your device.
techDescription: Next.js 15 · React · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Lucide Icons · Jalaali-js
heroAccent: without the slowdown and with privacy by default.
storyTitle: Built by engineers who were tired of slow and unsafe tools
storyParagraphs: For years, engineers have relied on old, slow, ad-filled websites for everyday tasks like converting Base64, inspecting JWTs, or validating regular expressions.
The bigger risk is sending sensitive JSON, API keys, and configuration files to unknown servers without knowing who stores or analyzes them.
ZebraCode was created to set a new standard: a fast, beautiful, local toolbox that stays useful even when the internet is unavailable.
manifesto: Privacy is not an option you enable in settings; it is the foundation of every technical tool.
manifestoCaption: ZebraCode technical manifesto · Zero Egress architecture

comparisonTitle: Why is ZebraCode safer by design than traditional online services?
comparisonDescription: The key difference is where processing happens: on an unknown server, or right inside your browser.

comparison.legacyDescription: Many free services send your request to their backend using HTTP POST.
legacySteps: Paste a token, private key, or sensitive JSON
Send the complete payload over the internet
Process and return data with server dependency and latency
comparison.localDescription: Tools run locally and keep data in the active browser tab's temporary memory.
localSteps: Enter data in the browser editor
Process locally without sending a single byte
Get an instant result ready to copy

faqs.question: Is any information really sent to your servers?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion and processing tools run in your browser, so the data itself is not sent to a processing server.

faqs.question: Why is ZebraCode free?
faqs.answer: Processing runs on the user's device, so we do not need expensive central processing infrastructure. The tools can remain free and independent.

faqs.question: How can I contribute?
faqs.answer: The project is open source. Fork the GitHub repository, add a tool, report a bug, or suggest a feature.

faqs.question: Can I use it without an internet connection?
faqs.answer: Many tools process data locally after the initial page load and do not need an internet connection for conversions.
